# Web sections

Sections and blocks for building web pages.

| Category | What goes in it |
| --- | --- |
| [Hero sections](hero-sections/) | The big first section at the top of a page |
| [Headers](headers/) | Site headers and top navigation |
| [Footers](footers/) | Site footers |
| [Feature sections](feature-sections/) | Feature grids and highlights |
| [Logo clouds](logo-clouds/) | Rows of customer and partner logos |
| [Stats sections](stats-sections/) | Numbers and stats blocks |
| [Testimonial sections](testimonial-sections/) | Testimonials and reviews |
| [Pricing sections](pricing-sections/) | Pricing tables and plan comparisons |
| [FAQ sections](faq-sections/) | FAQ blocks |
| [Team sections](team-sections/) | Team grids |
| [CTA sections](cta-sections/) | Call-to-action blocks |
| [Newsletter signups](newsletter-signups/) | Email signup blocks |
| [Contact sections](contact-sections/) | Contact forms and maps |
| [Blog sections](blog-sections/) | Blog post grids and lists |
| [Cookie banners](cookie-banners/) | Cookie and consent banners |

Each design gets its own folder inside a category. See [Adding a design](../README.md#adding-a-design).
